page.notes: Catchword "Christi" stands alone at the lower right and is recorded only in bottom_margin. Right-hand strip is the adjoining page edge and is omitted. Italic runs are marked from the scan; the boundaries of the italic passage around "Adversarii" are slightly uncertain. Spellings are copied as printed, including "Wiekum", "63.Illuminatio" (missing space after the printed full stop) and "Err. 157.". Long s was normalised to s.
